title: Tap-origin circular optical theme reveal
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas switches live HTML theme surfaces with an expanding circular optical mask centred on the exact pill or stage point you tap, bending typography and splitting RGB colours along the moving lens rim.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas switch live HTML theme surfaces from any tapped corner button, centre pill or stage coordinate using a circular optical mask with radial magnification, chromatic dispersion and updateElementGeometry() hit testing?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27, 412x915 at 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (1.03 MP, 7.87 MB initial, 8.11 MB peak), readPixels() confirms opposite-corner expansion flips plus specular peak (255), RGB dispersion (B-R=80 inner, R-B=61 outer) and radial refraction (delta 159), and updateElementGeometry() isolates active controls at 0%, 50% and 100%. Chrome 159 on Android and npm run check:jank stay not verified.
